title: Rules Written in Advance: Reading AgentSpec as a Coding Agent Builder
summary: AgentSpec enforces safety rules written before the agent runs. A close reading for coding agents, a case those rules cannot catch, and what enforcement that reasons about the task goal could look like.

title: Evaluated Once, Learning Forever: How the EU AI Act Handles Systems That Keep Changing
summary: The AI Act checks a system before release. What happens when the system keeps learning from its users? A step by step look at the rules, and nine reasons they may not be enough.

title: Three kinds of agent safety, and the one that keeps deleting databases
summary: Following instructions, refusing harm and avoiding catastrophic actions are different problems. Why a model can ace refusal benchmarks and still wipe your data.

title: Famous agent failures, read through proportional action
summary: Scoring public agent incidents on irreversibility, proportionality, authorization and context. Most started with a harmless request.

title: What did the agent change that it didn't need to?
summary: Twenty small tasks, one coding agent, and a git diff of everything it touched outside the task.

title: Does English safety training hold up when the request is in Kinyarwanda?
summary: A small pilot: the same risky agent tasks in English and Kinyarwanda, and what the model refuses in each.
